name: Original normal Former road movement and partial-move work
description: Fresh Gaians/Citizen/standard process on the same synthetic flat arid 40x80 map as former-work.v1. A declared UNIT1 bonus supplies one healthy normal Former and the Scout holds. Real Road commands pave two adjacent non-base eastward tiles before recording; each work or non-road move is followed by a real turn. Recording begins on the eastern road with full movement and no work. Installed rates are unchanged. Position is signed same-row tile steps east from that start, normalized for the round map. Movement spent is in thirds; original order, work counter, year delta and current-tile flags are observed. Research defaults and recognized turn/cancellation confirmations are accepted. No ZOC, combat, terrain variation, abilities or random partial-cost move claim.
